"License Key" means the unique activation code issued exclusively to the Licensee upon successful payment as per Section 5. The License Key is personal, non-transferable, and may not be shared, sold, or disclosed to any third party under any circumstances.
1.2

"Licensor" means the company or individual who developed, owns, and distributes AurumOS and retains full intellectual property rights at all times. "Licensee" means the business or individual who purchased and activated the Software and is bound by this Agreement from the moment of activation, including all partners, owners, directors, employees, and any person operating the Software on the Licensee's behalf. "Authorized Device" means the specific computer on which the Software is activated, bound by a multi-component hardware fingerprint.
1.3

Charge Sheet, BASTION AI and Outstanding Dues

"Charge Sheet" means the official pricing document provided at installation, attached as Schedule A and forming an inseparable part of this Agreement. "BASTION AI" means the embedded real-time security and threat detection system that monitors session integrity, database modifications, EXE file integrity, login patterns, and hardware identity. "Outstanding Dues" means any amount payable by the Licensee to the Licensor under this Agreement — including installment balances, renewal fees, or chargeable service fees — that remains unpaid after its due date, as distinct from a BASTION AI security suspension.

The Licensor grants the Licensee a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and revocable license to install and use the Software solely on the Authorized Device for internal business purposes within a single registered business premises, subject at all times to the Licensee remaining current on all Outstanding Dues. The Software permanently binds to the hardware fingerprint of the Authorized Device at first activation. Use on any other machine without prior written approval is a material breach. Multi-PC or LAN usage requires a separate Multi-PC License Plan purchased in advance.

Updates within the same major version are included in the license fee. New major version upgrades may be separately priced with at least 30 days' advance written notice. The Licensee may use the Software for all legitimate jewelry business operations including stock entry, billing, katti voucher management, thermal tag printing, credit ledger management, inventory analytics, and year-end closing within the licensed premises, and may take regular local backups of the database for its own continuity.

The Licensee must not bypass, disable, or interfere with BASTION AI, session token verification, hardware fingerprint binding, or any other embedded security mechanism.
⚠ Critical Warning Any attempt to bypass, tamper with, or disable the BASTION AI system will result in automatic suspension. Investigation and unlocking is a chargeable service as per Section 6.2.

License Fee — Strictly Non-Refundable

The Licensor requires a 50% advance payment before commencing any installation, setup, or configuration work; the remaining balance is due on or before the day of installation unless a written installment schedule signed by the Licensor states otherwise.
⚠ Strictly Non-Refundable — No Exceptions All amounts paid under this Agreement are non-refundable under all circumstances without exception, including where the Licensee changes its mind, decides not to proceed, switches to another solution, closes its business, or is dissatisfied with any feature. The Licensor strongly encourages a full demonstration before any payment is made.
5.2

Default, Cure Period and Suspension for Non-Payment

If any Outstanding Dues remain unpaid beyond their due date, the Licensor shall issue a written default notice to the Licensee's registered contact (email and/or WhatsApp constituting valid written notice under Section 14.3) specifying the amount due and a cure period of not less than seven (7) calendar days within which payment must be made.

If the Outstanding Dues remain unpaid upon expiry of the cure period, the Licensor may, at its sole discretion and without further notice, suspend or restrict the Licensee's access to the Software until the Outstanding Dues are paid in full, in addition to any other remedy available at law. Suspension under this Section is a distinct and independently exercisable right of the Licensor, separate from and not limited by the BASTION AI provisions of Section 6, and does not require any security-related trigger to be exercised.

The Licensee's business data stored locally on the Authorized Device is not deleted, altered, or accessed by the Licensor as a result of any suspension under this Section, and full functionality resumes promptly upon clearance of all Outstanding Dues plus any applicable reactivation charge listed in the Charge Sheet.

No Liability for Consequences of Licensee's Own Default. The Licensee acknowledges and agrees that any business disruption, loss of access, loss of use, or consequential loss arising from a suspension exercised under this Section 5.2 is a direct and foreseeable consequence of the Licensee's own failure to pay Outstanding Dues, and the Licensor shall bear no liability whatsoever — whether direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential — for any such disruption or loss, without prejudice to the general limitations of liability in Section 9.
5.3

Chargeback and Payment Reversal

Any chargeback, payment reversal, or dispute initiated by the Licensee with its bank or payment provider after the License Key is issued shall result in immediate suspension pending resolution and, if the chargeback is found to be unwarranted, permanent revocation of the license without refund. The Licensor reserves the right to pursue full legal and financial remedies including recovery of the outstanding amount, damages, costs, and interest at 18% per annum or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower.
5.4

GST, Renewal and Grace Period

All fees are exclusive of GST, charged additionally at the prevailing rate, with a proper GST invoice issued for all payments. Annual licenses must be renewed before expiry; a 15-day grace period follows expiry during which the Software continues to function, after which it enters restricted mode. Restricted mode does not affect the Licensee's stored business data.
6

BASTION AI Suspension and License Revocation

6.1

Monitoring and Automatic Suspension

BASTION AI operates continuously and may automatically suspend the Licensee's account without prior notice upon detecting EXE file modification, external database editing, session token tampering, unauthorized device copying, or repeated failed login attempts exceeding the permitted threshold. This is separate from, and operates independently of, any suspension for non-payment under Section 5.2.
6.2

Suspension Unlock Charges and False Positives

Investigation and unlock following a BASTION AI suspension is chargeable and payable before unlock, regardless of intent, unless the Licensor's investigation confirms a genuine false positive (e.g., Windows updates, antivirus interference, legitimate hardware change), in which case the account is unlocked within 24 hours at no charge. The Licensor's determination, based on the technical evidence available in system logs, is final.
6.3

Permanent Revocation Grounds

The Licensor may permanently revoke the License Key without refund for: confirmed intentional tampering; sharing of the License Key; attempted reverse engineering; unauthorized hardware duplication; an unwarranted chargeback; or repeated or uncured default under Section 5.2. Upon the Software's next online verification check following revocation, it enters a permanently locked state. The Licensee is notified via registered contact details.
⚠ No Refund on Revocation License revocation due to any violation of this Agreement carries no right to refund of any fees paid, whether advance or full payment, under any circumstances.
